subject: [RFC PATCH 07/57] mm/collapse: sketch the new anonymous collapse engine

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new anonymous collapse engine to improve the scalability and functionality of memory collapsing in Linux. The current implementation is limited by its exclusive lock, which stops every fault in the address space for each huge page. The new engine addresses this issue by quiescing its sources like migration does, allowing it to run under mmap_read throughout. It also carries a batch of windows through each step together and makes decisions per window rather than per table. This patch lays out the design of the new engine without filling in the implementation details yet.
